en.commentary: The Litter-Robot 4 stays my top recommendation in 2026, and the arrival of the Litter-Robot 5 is exactly why. Whisker's new flagship costs $799 for the standard model and $899 for the Pro, and what that extra money buys is WasteID, a nicer LCD, a built-in carpet tray and two extra days of drawer capacity. Those are refinements on a machine that already sifted better than anything else I have used. At $699 the Litter-Robot 4 keeps the five infrared beams and four load cells that make its sensor package the most cautious in the category, still handles cats up to 25 lb, and still catches the small urine clumps that cheaper drums smear against the globe wall. Buy the 5 Pro if you have a cat over 25 lb or you genuinely want facial recognition on camera. Everyone else gets 95 percent of the machine for $200 less. PETKIT owns the interesting middle. The Purobot Ultra at $799 is the only box here that seals and bags the waste itself, which turns emptying from a weekly chore into a monthly one, and its 20-sensor xSecure array plus 15-cat facial recognition make it the most automated thing on the market. The Purobot Max Pro 2 at $559 is the smarter buy for most multi-cat homes: same AI health tracking, same 210-degree camera, 8L sealed bin, $240 less. The pattern across this whole category in 2026 is that health monitoring has become the competitive axis. Every box above $400 now weighs your cat and logs visit frequency, and those two numbers catch kidney disease and urinary blockages weeks before you would notice at home. That is the real reason to spend the money.

highlights.title: The Litter-Robot 4 wins because the Litter-Robot 5 exists
highlights.body: Whisker's own comparison lays out the upgrade honestly: the 5 adds WasteID, an LCD screen, a built-in carpet tray, a 30 lb ceiling and two extra days of drawer capacity for $100 more, with the Pro's dual cameras costing another $100 on top plus $8 a month for Whisker+ facial recognition. Sifting quality, sensor safety and app basics are unchanged. That makes the 4 the better purchase at $699 for the overwhelming majority of households, and it makes the 5 Pro a targeted upgrade for people with cats over 25 lb or a genuine appetite for camera analytics. I would rather put the $200 into a year of good clumping litter.

highlights.title: Auto-bagging is the only feature that changes your weekly routine
highlights.body: Every box on this list scoops. Exactly one, the PETKIT Purobot Ultra at $799, seals the waste into a bag and drops it for you. With a 10L bin that stretches to roughly 20 days for a single cat, the maintenance interval moves from weekly to monthly, and you never open a drawer full of clumps. Twenty sensors and a 36dB running noise mean it does this without spooking the cat. If the part of litter box ownership you actually hate is the moment of emptying, this is the machine that solves it, and nothing else in the category comes close.

highlights.title: Health tracking is now the reason to spend over $400
highlights.body: The PETKIT Purobot Max Pro 2 at $559 logs each cat's weight and visit frequency through a 210-degree fisheye camera and flags stool appearance in the app. The Litter-Robot line does the same through load cells. Cats hide illness by instinct, and a jump from three visits a day to eight is the earliest visible sign of a urinary blockage, which is an emergency in male cats. A box that timestamps every visit and weighs your cat several times a day is running passive diagnostics you would otherwise pay a vet to approximate. That is worth more than any odour feature on the spec sheet.

highlights.title: Open-top and low-entry designs solve the problem enclosed drums create
highlights.body: The Neakasa M1 at $499 keeps the entry unobstructed so a cat can see out while inside, and the PETKIT Purobot Max 3 at $399 uses an 8-inch low entry aimed at senior and large-breed cats. The PetSafe ScoopFree SmartSpin sits just 12 inches tall for the same reason. These matter because the most expensive automatic litter box is the one your cat refuses to use, and refusal usually traces to a narrow entryway or a dark enclosed chamber. If your cat is nervous, arthritic, or over ten years old, start here rather than with a premium globe.

highlights.title: Budget picks are real now, and $299 buys a working machine
highlights.body: The Meowant MW-SC01 at $299 runs under 40dB, takes bentonite, tofu or mixed litter, and steps in at 4.8 inches. The CATLINK Scooper Luxury Pro-X at $439 gives multi-cat homes a 65L globe, a 13L drawer and four independent safety systems including microwave radar. Neither matches the Litter-Robot 4's sifting precision, and both use smaller waste bins that need emptying more often. For a single indoor cat under 15 lb in an apartment, that trade is entirely reasonable, and it is the first year I would say so without hesitation.

zh-tw.commentary:
老實說，2026 年我還是把 Litter-Robot 4 放第一，而 Litter-Robot 5 的推出正好是最好的理由。Whisker 新旗艦標準版 799 美元、Pro 版 899 美元，多花的錢換到的是 WasteID 尿便辨識、LCD 螢幕、內建地毯托盤跟多兩天的抽屜容量。這些都是好東西，但它們是加在一台本來篩砂就已經最強的機器上。

699 美元的 LR4 保留了五組紅外線加四組重量感測，安全機制在全品類裡最保守，一樣支援到 25 磅的大貓，一樣抓得住那些便宜滾筒會抹在球體內壁上的小尿團。台灣官方代理售價 NT$23,800，價格算硬但這是唯一有正式進口保固的高階選擇。

貓超過 25 磅或是真的想要貓臉辨識鏡頭，那就直上 5 Pro。其他人用少 200 美元拿到 95% 的機器，這筆帳很好算。

PETKIT 把中段市場整個吃下來。799 美元的 Purobot Ultra 是這份榜單裡唯一會自己封袋打包的，倒垃圾從每週變成每月一次，20 顆感測器加 15 隻貓臉辨識讓它成為自動化程度最高的一台，台灣官網促銷價 NT$27,888。559 美元的 Purobot Max Pro 2 對多貓家庭更划算，同樣的 AI 健康監測、同樣的 210 度魚眼鏡頭、8 公升密封桶，台灣賣 NT$17,888，比 Ultra 省了一萬塊。

2026 年整個品類的競爭主軸已經轉到健康監測。400 美元以上的機種現在全部都會秤貓體重、記錄如廁次數，這兩個數字能在你自己察覺前好幾週就抓出腎病跟泌尿道阻塞。這才是花這筆錢的真正理由。

highlights.title: Litter-Robot 4 之所以贏，是因為 Litter-Robot 5 出來了
highlights.body: Whisker 自己的比較表把升級講得很清楚：5 代多了 WasteID、LCD 螢幕、內建地毯托盤、承重拉到 30 磅、抽屜多撐兩天，售價多 100 美元；Pro 版的雙鏡頭再多 100 美元，貓臉辨識還要另外付 Whisker+ 每月 8 美元。篩砂品質、安全感測、App 基本功能三項完全沒變。這就讓 699 美元的 4 代對絕大多數家庭是更好的選擇，5 Pro 則變成大貓家庭跟真的想玩鏡頭數據的人的專屬升級。省下來的 200 美元拿去買一整年的好貓砂，我覺得更實在。

highlights.title: 自動打包封袋是唯一真正改變你每週生活的功能
highlights.body: 這份榜單上每一台都會自動鏟砂，但只有 799 美元的 PETKIT Purobot Ultra 會把廢料封進袋子裡放好。10 公升集便桶單貓可以撐大概 20 天，維護週期從每週變成每月，而且你永遠不用打開一個裝滿貓屎的抽屜。20 顆感測器加 36 分貝的運轉音量代表它做這些事的時候不會嚇到貓。台灣促銷價 NT$27,888，如果你最討厭的就是倒集便桶那一刻，這台是唯一解，整個品類沒有第二個選項。

highlights.title: 健康監測才是花超過一萬二的理由
highlights.body: 台灣賣 NT$17,888 的 PETKIT Purobot Max Pro 2 用 210 度魚眼鏡頭分貓記錄體重跟如廁次數，還會在 App 標記便便外觀。Litter-Robot 系列則是靠重量感測做同一件事。貓天生會藏病，一天上廁所從三次變八次是泌尿道阻塞最早的可見徵兆，公貓遇到這個是急診等級的事。一台會標記每次如廁時間、一天秤好幾次體重的貓砂機，等於在幫你做被動健康篩檢，這個價值遠大於規格表上任何一項除臭功能。

highlights.title: 開放式跟低入口設計，解決的是密閉滾筒製造出來的問題
highlights.body: 499 美元的 Neakasa M1 入口完全不遮蔽，貓在裡面看得到外面，台灣有原廠一年保固賣 NT$12,888；399 美元的 PETKIT Purobot Max 3 用 8 吋寬低入口，專門對付老貓跟大體型貓；PetSafe ScoopFree SmartSpin 機身只有 12 吋高也是同樣的思路。這件事很重要，因為最貴的自動貓砂盆就是你家貓不肯用的那一台，而拒用的原因通常就是入口太窄或裡面太暗太封閉。家裡的貓膽小、有關節問題、或是超過十歲，從這幾台開始挑會比直接買高階球體機安全。

highlights.title: 平價選項今年真的能用，一萬塊有找就買得到堪用機
highlights.body: 299 美元的 Meowant MW-SC01 運轉低於 40 分貝，礦砂豆腐砂混合砂通吃，入口只有 4.8 吋高，台幣大概一萬以內；439 美元的 CATLINK Scooper Luxury Pro-X 給多貓家庭 65 公升滾筒、13 公升集便抽屜跟含微波雷達的四道安全機制。這兩台篩砂精準度都比不上 Litter-Robot 4，集便桶也比較小要更常倒。但如果你家只有一隻 15 磅以下的室內貓，住的又是台北那種坪數，這個取捨完全說得過去，而且今年是我第一次可以毫不猶豫這樣講。

en.commentary: This ranking is new and it holds this week, and the connected-device news of the past three weeks is directly relevant. Several boxes in this category carry cameras and cloud-connected health monitoring, and the SharkNinja and DJI disclosures showed what a gap in vendor cloud infrastructure can expose. A litter box camera sits in a bathroom or a utility room, which is a placement worth thinking about before you enable the feature. Put these on a guest network and disable the camera if the health tracking is not something you actively use. On the product itself, my scoring priorities are firm. Safety sensing outranks everything, which is why the Litter-Robot 4 leads with five infrared beams and four weight sensors, and supports cats up to 25 pounds. A box that cycles while a cat is inside is a catastrophic failure, and sensor redundancy is the only real defence against it. Second is the consumable bill. Proprietary bags, carbon filters, and clumping litter add up to a meaningful annual cost that the sticker price hides completely, and it is the number most buyers discover in month four. Work out the yearly total before you commit. Third is whether your cat will use it, which no specification predicts. Introduce it slowly and keep the old box available for a fortnight.

highlights.title: Sensor redundancy is the only specification that matters for safety
highlights.body: A box that begins a cycle while a cat is inside is a catastrophic failure, and no marketing claim substitutes for overlapping detection. The Litter-Robot 4 leads this table with five infrared beams and four weight sensors, supporting cats up to 25 pounds. If you have a large cat or a kitten, count the sensors before you compare anything else.

highlights.title: Work out the annual consumable bill before the purchase price
highlights.body: Proprietary waste bags, carbon filters, and the clumping litter these units require add up to a real yearly figure that the shelf price hides completely. Most buyers discover it in month four. Find the part numbers, find the replacement intervals, and calculate the total, because the cheaper box is often the more expensive system.

highlights.title: Camera-equipped boxes deserve the same network treatment as any camera
highlights.body: Several units here carry cameras and cloud health monitoring, and the vendor cloud disclosures of the past three weeks apply directly. This device sits in a bathroom or utility room, which is worth considering before you enable the feature. Put it on a guest network, and switch the camera off if you are not actively using the health tracking.

highlights.title: No specification predicts whether your cat will accept it
highlights.body: The mechanism, the noise, the entry height, and the litter texture all matter to a cat and none of them appear in a comparison table. Introduce the new box gradually, keep the old one available for at least two weeks, and check the return policy before you order. This is the failure mode that no amount of research prevents.

這張排名還很新，這禮拜維持不動，而過去三週的連網裝置新聞跟它直接相關。

這個品類有好幾款貓砂盆帶著鏡頭跟雲端健康監測，而 SharkNinja 與 DJI 的漏洞揭露，示範了廠商雲端架構的缺口能暴露什麼。貓砂盆的鏡頭放在浴室或工作陽台，這個擺放位置在你啟用功能之前值得想一下。把它們放到訪客網路，如果健康追蹤不是你會主動用的功能，就把鏡頭關掉。

第三是你家的貓會不會用，這件事沒有任何規格預測得到。慢慢引導，舊砂盆留著兩週。

Self cleaning litter boxes held steady and safety is the factor I weight most heavily here, so I want to explain what that means in practice.

An automatic litter box contains a mechanism that moves while a cat may be inside it. Every unit in this ranking uses sensors to detect occupancy and pause, and the quality of that detection varies. What I look for is redundant sensing, meaning weight sensors and infrared beams working together, so a single sensor failure does not result in the mechanism operating with a cat present.

Smaller cats and kittens are the specific risk, because a light animal may not trigger a weight sensor alone. If you have a kitten or a cat under about eight pounds, check the manufacturer's stated minimum weight for detection before you buy.

The second thing I weight is health monitoring. A box that records each cat's weight and visit frequency detects changes that indicate urinary or kidney problems earlier than an owner typically notices. For a multi cat household that data has real veterinary value.

The Litter-Robot 4 holds first at 9.3 on redundant safety sensing, reliable operation and health tracking that works with multiple cats.

One practical note about transition. Cats often refuse a new box initially. Run the new unit alongside the old one for two weeks with the automatic cycle disabled, then enable it. Forcing an immediate switch is how households end up with a cat eliminating outside the box.

Litter-Robot 4 stays first, and the way I judge these machines is by the boring details that decide whether you keep using them. I check how quietly the cycle runs, how often I need to empty the waste drawer, whether the cat's weight sensor behaves, and how easy the globe is to wash. Give the cat time to adjust by leaving the machine switched off for a few days with the door open, then run it while you are home. Use the litter the manufacturer recommends, because clumping quality changes how well the sifting works. Place it somewhere with room around it, and plan to wipe the sensors every few weeks.
